lines.text: Twenty-three tabs. Four apps. A folder of screenshots you'll never find again.
Research shouldn't look like this.
Meet Axiom.
Paper on the left, thinking on the right. Lasso anything: text lands as Markdown, equations as LaTeX, and every snippet links back to its exact spot.
lines.say: Paper on the left, thinking on the right. Lasso anything: text lands as Markdown, equations as lay-tech, and every snippet links back to its exact spot.

lines.text: Need space? Spread two fingers and the page opens up. Sketch roughly, double-tap, and it snaps clean.
Type LaTeX and it renders live. Link ideas with double brackets, and backlinks build themselves.
lines.say: Type lay-tech and it renders live. Link ideas with double brackets, and backlinks build themselves.

lines.text: Tag a note as a flashcard. Axiom schedules reviews right before you'd forget.
Search everything in a keystroke, see how ideas connect, and gather a whole topic into one Lens.
Write on your laptop and watch it appear on your tablet. Real-time, end-to-end encrypted, and fully offline.
Every page is plain Markdown in your own GitHub or GitLab repo. Full history. Zero lock-in.
And AI that reads your handwriting, transcribes equations, suggests tags and writes your flashcards. Free tiers, a local model, or no key at all.
That's Axiom.
Now let's set it up. Start the clock.
Clone, install, run. Three commands, Node 20 or newer.
lines.say: Clone, install, run. Three commands, Node twenty or newer.

lines.text: Click Install, or Add to Home Screen on iPad. It works offline from here.
lines.say: Click Install, or Add to Home Screen on eye-pad. It works offline from here.

lines.text: Drop in a PDF, EPUB or slide deck.
lines.say: Drop in a P D F, an ee-pub, or a slide deck.

lines.text: Start the relay, create a sync key, paste it on your other device. Connected and encrypted.
Now backup. Create a GitHub token for one repo, paste it into Settings, and every change is committed automatically.
Finally, AI. Grab a free Gemini key, paste it in, hit Test. Prefer local? Point it at Ollama.
lines.say: Finally, A I. Grab a free Gemini key, paste it in, hit Test. Prefer local? Point it at oh-llama.

lines.text: Done.
Axiom.
Free. Open source. Yours.
